mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_billing_request (id, doc_no, period_type, from_date, to_date, store, customer_code, customer_branch, status, process_status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{docNo}, #{periodType}, #{fromDate}, #{toDate}, #{store}, #{customerCode}, #{customerBranch}, #{status}, #{processStatus}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO customer_billing_request_detail (id, billing_id, customer_code, customer_branch, item_code, uom, sales_qty, return_qty, billing_qty, unit_price, line_amount, actual_return_qty) VALUES (#{id}, #{billingId}, #{customerCode}, #{customerBranch}, #{itemCode}, #{uom}, #{salesQty}, #{returnQty}, #{billingQty}, #{unitPrice}, #{lineAmount}, #{actualReturnQty})
mapper.select:
SELECT h.id, h.doc_no, h.period_type, h.from_date, h.to_date, h.store, h.customer_code, h.customer_branch, h.status, h.process_status, h.created_by, h.released_at, h.created_at, h.updated_at FROM customer_billing_request h
ORDER BY h.created_at DESC LIMIT #{c.perPage} OFFSET #{c.offset}

SELECT id, billing_id, customer_code, customer_branch, item_code, uom, sales_qty, return_qty, billing_qty, unit_price, line_amount, actual_return_qty FROM customer_billing_request_detail WHERE billing_id = #{billingId} ORDER BY customer_code, item_code
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_billing_request SET status = #{status}, released_at = #{releasedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(doc_no FROM 5) AS BIGINT)), 0) FROM customer_billing_request WHERE doc_no ~ '^CBR-[0-9]+$'
